column1: # Lamakan: the caravan wakes and Mia takes point.

column3: Isaac, look at the caravan.\nThere must be forty of\nthem, and they're waking.{end_wait}
They're after the light,\nIsaac. We should turn back\nbefore they reach us.{end_wait}
Turn back? Why? We could\njust burn them where they\nstand. It would be cleaner.{end_wait}
Nobody is burning anyone.\nStay behind me, and let me\ntry to talk to them.{end_wait}
They aren't afraid of us.\nThey're afraid of whatever\nis in their own heads.{end_wait}
Then you'll get yourself\nkilled trying. I won't\nstand here and watch.{end_wait}
We can't help them. Keep\nmoving, and don't look\nback.{end_wait}
Isaac, they're calling your\nname. How do they know it?{end_wait}
Good. Let them call. We're\nnot stopping for ghosts.{end_wait}
Keep up, Isaac. I'll walk\npoint from here, because\nKalay won't wait for us.{end_wait}
She didn't look back once,\nIsaac. Not at us, and not\nat them.{end_wait}
